verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote-desktop and teams-access product, and AI-generated insights from usage or audit data are a plausible feature for such a product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions any AI-generated insights or suggestions. The Teams API's audit logs and reporting are a data-access building block, not AI insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
